artworks.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.9 × 8.5 cm (2 11/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a triumphal procession. The scene features a large gathering of figures, with a central path where a person on a donkey is followed by others in robes. The figures are celebrating, some holding objects resembling palm fronds. In the background, there are imposing structures like domed buildings and towers, along with palm trees. The composition is balanced, with a strong sense of depth leading the viewer's eye through the scene. The lines in the drawing depict a historical moment filled with jubilation and solemnity.

artworks.title: Caesar's Coin
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.9 × 8.3 cm (2 11/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with a group of figures. The setting features an elaborate, classical architectural design, with ornate columns and arches framing the scene. Various figures are depicted engaging in what appears to be a discussion or transaction. The architecture provides a sense of depth and grandeur, with a background that extends the scene through a series of archways and distant activities. The figures wear a range of robes and hats, suggesting historical or traditional attire. This drawing showcases a rich interplay of line and detail, capturing both the architectural elements and the interactions within the space.

artworks.title: Conversion of Paul
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.7 × 8.7 cm (2 5/8 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a battle scene with soldiers on foot and horseback engaged in combat. In the background, there is a castle on a hill and a figure watching from the clouds above. The detailed composition conveys movement and drama through line work and hatching. The perspective and expressions of the figures capture the chaos of battle.

artworks.title: View of the Festival
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23 × 30.2 cm (9 1/16 × 11 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand equestrian parade or spectacle in an arena. The full depiction showcases an oval-shaped arena filled with numerous horse riders engaged in choreographed movements and displays. The central area is bustling with figures on horseback, forming an intricate, winding pattern as they navigate around the arena. The edges of the arena are lined with spectators, filling the stands and balconies of the surrounding architectural structures. These buildings exhibit a classic architectural style, with rows of windows and balustrades densely occupied by onlookers. The lower portion of the drawing also presents several figures on foot, some carrying props or engaging in various activities associated with the event. The scene captures a historical or celebratory event marked by its organization and grandeur.

artworks.title: The Coiffure
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: Nude from the waist up, a woman gathers her hair in her raised hands as she sits before a mirror in this vertical print. The large mirror is to our right, and the woman’s body is mostly turned away from us. Her head is bowed but a loose tendril of dark hair hanging beside one cheek is reflected in the mirror. Her lower body is wrapped in a voluminous cloth as she leans forward on a curved, upholstered armchair. Her facial features, the contours of her body, and the folds of the towel are all delineated with thin black strokes. The mirror is set into a light gray wall in front of the woman but the wall to our left, past her shoulders, is blank. A few inscribed lines suggest a floral pattern on the floor beneath her bare feet. The artist signed the work in graphite under the lower right corner, “Mary Cassatt.”

artworks.title: Afternoon Tea Party
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint with touches of gold metallic paint on laid paper
artworks.description: Two women with pale, peachy skin sit next to a table holding a silver tray and royal-blue tea cups and saucers in this colored, vertical etching and aquatint. Faint black lines outline the women, their features, clothing, and objects in the room, and each area is filled in a flat color. The women face each other and take up most of the composition. Both have oval faces, rounded noses, pale pink lips, and their hair is pulled up and back. The woman to our right has brown hair and leans forward as she holds up a blue plate with her right hand, closer to us. The other hand rests on the arm of her tawny-brown chair. Her dress has a petal pink bodice and long skirt with fog-white long sleeves and white fabric covering her chest and tucked into the low, rounded neckline. The other woman wears a blue cap over black hair. The hat has a celery-green feather and is tied in a bow under the chin. She wears a hip-length, charcoal-gray cloak over a pale, sage-green dress. She looks down at the plate and holds what might be a cookie or biscuit with one hand and a cup and a dish-like saucer with the other. Her lips are downturned and her head pulled slightly back to create a double chin. She sits upright in another brown chair. In the lower right corner of the sheet, the round gray table is barely bigger than the round gray tray it holds. On it are two more cups and saucers and a silver jug, presumably holding milk. What might be another cup and saucer set or the teapot is cut off by the right edge of the paper. The rims of the cups and saucers are painted gold. A very pale, mint-green screen with openings across the top stands to the left behind the second woman, and a window is behind the first. Spiky fronds of a houseplant angle up toward the sunlight and a coral-pink curtain is pulled to the left side. Squiggles and flowers printed in rust red suggest a pattern on white curtains covering the window and the pink curtain to the left. The wall behind the screen is straw yellow. The artist signed and inscribed the sheet under the lower right corner, “Imprimée par l'artiste et M. Leroy, Mary Cassatt (25 épreuves).” A tiny dark blue stamp with a short, wide C overlaid on a capital letter M is inked along the bottom edge of the image.

artworks.title: Afternoon Tea Party
artworks.medium: drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: Two women with sit next to a table holding a tray with teacups and saucers in this vertical etching and aquatint. Faint black lines outline the women, their features, clothing, and objects in the room. The women face each other and take up most of the composition. Both have oval faces, rounded noses, and their hair is pulled up and back. The woman to our right leans forward as she holds up a plate with her right hand, closer to us. The other hand rests on the arm of her chair. Her dress has a tight-fitting bodice, long sleeves, and a long skirt. The other woman’s cap has a feather and is tied in a bow under the chin. She wears a hip-length cloak over a long dress. She looks down at the plate and holds what might be a cookie or biscuit with one hand and a cup and a dish-like saucer with the other. Her lips are downturned, her head pulled slightly back to create a double chin, and she sits upright in her chair. In the lower right corner of the sheet, the round table is barely bigger than the tray it holds. On it are two more cups and saucers and a jug, presumably holding milk. What might be another cup-and-saucer set or the teapot is cut off by the right edge of the paper. A screen with openings across the top stands to the left behind the second woman, and a window is behind the first. Spiky fronds of a houseplant angle across the window, and a curtain is pulled to the left side. Squiggles on that second curtain suggest a floral pattern. A few areas are colored in gray, including the second woman’s cloak, the tray, and the milk jug.

artworks.title: The Fitting
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals in a sketch form. The central figure is shown from approximately the waist up with their head slightly turned downward and hand poised near their chest. They have short, dark hair and wear a high-necked long-sleeve outfit with a loose scarf or shawl around their shoulders. To the right is a second figure shown from behind in a similar posture. They also have short, dark hair and wear a similar outfit. Below the central figure is a third individual, visible from the top of their head and shoulders as they face away from the viewer. The background is plain, with no distinct objects or scenery visible. The artwork is signed by Mary Cassatt in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: In the Opera Box (No. 3)
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She is positioned slightly to the side as if she is seated and looking over her shoulder. Her hair is styled in a short, neatly combed manner that frames her face. She is dressed in a formal garment, possibly a dress, with her shoulders exposed. In her hands, she holds a large, ornate fan that partially covers the lower half of her face and chest. The background features a curved railing, indicative of an interior setting, possibly a theater or an opera house, with indistinct hints of people or decorations in the upper section.

artworks.title: In the Opera Box (No. 3)
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length view of a person. The person is facing slightly towards the viewer with their attention directed to the front. Their facial features are rendered with simple lines and shading, suggesting a soft and calm demeanor. The person's hair is short and depicted with simple strokes. They are wearing a garment that covers the shoulders. The person is holding a large fan in front of them, featuring a series of lines radiating from a central point. The background consists of abstract swirling shapes suggesting drapery or cloth. The signature "Mary Cassatt" is located in the lower right corner of the image.

artworks.title: In the Opera Box (No. 3) [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a seated person from the waist up. The person appears relaxed, with a slight smile on their face. They have short hair and are holding an open fan. The background includes a circular architectural feature and vertical lines resembling wood paneling or drapery.

artworks.title: In the Opera Box [verso]
artworks.medium: transferred softground with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, seated with a relaxed posture. She has delicate facial features, short hair, and is wearing an off-the-shoulder garment. She is holding a large decorative fan in front of her. The background features abstract decorative elements, presented in a monochromatic brown hue.

artworks.title: Mimi Holding a Japanese Fan
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an upper half view of a person in a seated position. The person is facing forward and slightly towards the left, with their left arm resting on a surface. Their face is shown in profile, revealing fine facial features and short hair. The clothing of the person appears to be light. The background has a textured pattern with dot-like formations on the right and linear, striated patterns on the left. There are no visible jewelry items or objects. The etching is signed "M. C." in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Mimi as a Brunette
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the bust and arm of a woman resting on her left arm against a cushioned surface. She has shoulder-length dark hair styled back, and prominent facial features with defined eyes and a composed expression. The woman is wearing intricately detailed clothing and holding a round object in her hand. Beside her, there are sketches of large flower-like shapes. The background is minimally detailed with sketchy lines.

artworks.title: The Lamp
artworks.medium: drypoint and softground etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated and turned to the side. She is shown from the upper back up, with her head in profile. Her facial features and hair are delicately sketched. She is depicted wearing a garment with a V-shaped neckline at the back. In the background, there is a small table with decorative objects and a draped form resembling a curtain or tapestry. The sketch is light and elegantly rendered.

artworks.title: Lydia at Afternoon Tea
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting in a chair with a tea set on a table in front of them. The person's upper body is visible from the side, and they appear relaxed. The individual's face is not detailed, and they are wearing a dark garment. The chair has a patterned fabric, and the background is textured with light and dark contrasts.

artworks.title: Maternal Caress
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting in an upholstered chair and tightly hugging a nude, blond child in this vertical, colored print. Both have pale, peach-toned skin. The woman’s black hair is pulled back though a couple tendrils curl on her forehead. Her eyes are downcast and her pink lips parted. She wears a long, cream-white dress dotted with blush-pink, petal-like forms. One arm is under the baby’s chubby bottom and the other braces the child behind the shoulders. The baby wraps their arms around the woman’s neck so they are cheek to cheek. The chair sits in front of a bed with a boxy frame and a pillowy white mattress. The upholstery on the woman’s chair and the wallpaper behind her are patterned with dusky rose-pink flowers and vines against butter yellow. The floor is coral orange. A mark with an oval, or a mirrored C, over an uppercase M, is stamped in royal blue at the bottom center of the print.

artworks.title: Peasant Mother and Child
artworks.medium: drypoint
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of two individuals: an adult and a child. The adult is sitting and facing slightly away, with their head turned toward the child who is resting on their shoulder. The adult's facial features are not visible, but their hair is neatly combed back into a bun. The child has short, straight hair with bangs, and is shown looking slightly off to the side. The adult is clothed in a garment with long sleeves, while the child is wearing a similar style of clothing. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by either person. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Preparing Bill for an Outing
artworks.medium: softground etching
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an adult and a child depicted from the waist up. The adult is seated, holding the child on their lap with arms around for support. The adult has short, dark hair and subtle facial features, while the child wears a headband, sits upright, and has round eyes and a small mouth. Both figures wear simple clothing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Portrait of the Artist's Mother
artworks.medium: color softground etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: This print shows an elderly woman seated, slightly angled to the left, with her head resting on her hand. Her facial features are soft, and she has beige skin and her hair is gray and pulled back neatly. She is wearing a high-collared black dress and a light-colored shawl over her shoulders. The background is a muted brown with green and yellow floral decorations suggesting bouquets of green and yellow flowers placed on either side of her.

artworks.title: Woman Bathing
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: A woman bends over a basin of water on a washstand in this vertical, colored print. The woman is angled away from us so only her ear and the curve of her forehead are visible beyond her hunched shoulder. Her upper body is bare, her striped dress having been unfastened so it hangs around her waist. Light reflects off her dark hair, which is tied up and back. She cups her hands in the basin. Two bottles sit at the back corner of the washstand, and a mirror reflects the top of her head. A handled pitcher sits at the front left corner of the boxy washstand. The artist signed the work in graphite under the lower right corner, “Mary Cassatt etat.” Another inscription to the left reads “E1005.”

artworks.title: Woman Bathing
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: Created with areas of muted color, a woman with pale skin bends over a basin on a washstand in this vertical print. The edges of the woman’s body and clothing, the washstand, and bowl and bottles in front of her are outlined with dark brown or black lines. The woman’s body is angled to our left and away from us, so we see her bare back and her left arm as that hand dips into the water in the bowl. The bodice of her dress is loose around her waist, and her full skirt falls to the floor. The fabric is patterned with ivory-white, sage-green, and pale pink vertical stripes. She hunches over the basin so we see her left ear and the back of her lowered head. Her chestnut-brown hair is pulled up and back. The basin is cream white, and two glass bottles sit next to it, to our left. The washstand has a raised ledge around the sides and back. A rectangular mirror is mounted on the back edge, and the top of the woman’s head is reflected there. The washstand and edges of the mirror are peanut-brown, and the inset top surface of the stand is white. We look slightly down onto a white, handled pitcher on the floor in front of the left corner of the washstand. The pitcher has a wide opening, and tea-brown flowers are painted on the rounded body. The wall behind the washstand and the wall reflected in the mirror is muted slate blue. The carpet across the bottom of the composition is patterned with parchment-brown flowers and leaves against a darker, denim-blue background. At the bottom center edge of the printed image, a royal-blue C and M are overlapped. An inscription written lightly in graphite in the margin beneath the right corner of the printed image is difficult to make out.

artworks.title: In the Omnibus
artworks.medium: drypoint with graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: Printed with black lines on cream-white paper, two women, one holding a baby on her lap, sit on the long bench seat of an omnibus in this vertical composition. The women and their full skirts take up almost the width of the composition against the bench, which extends off both sides. The woman to our left wears a high-collared dress, gloves, and hat. She looks off to our right, almost in profile. She has a round face and the hint of a double chin. One gloved hand rests on a cane. The other woman holds the baby and tips her head down toward the child. Both women’s black hair is pulled up under their hats. The baby wears a ruffled bonnet, a blousy garment, stockings, and shoes. A row of windows behind them, parallel to the top of the bench, open onto an arched bridge spanning a river with boats. To our left, the water’s edge is lined with puffy forms reminiscent of trees and bushes.

artworks.title: The Visitor
artworks.medium: softground etching, aquatint, and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women depicted in a monochromatic etching style. One woman is standing and one is seated. The standing woman is shown from head to toe, slightly angled towards the seated woman, and resting one hand on the back of a chair. She has her hair styled in a bun or short crop, with her facial features appearing soft and somewhat indistinct due to shading. She wears a long dress that falls to the floor. The seated woman is shown from the waist up, turned towards the standing woman. Her hands are possibly resting in her lap or on a table. Her hair is styled up, and her facial features are also undefined due to shading. The seated woman wears clothing with long sleeves. The setting appears to be indoors, with textured walls or drapery in the background, possibly curtains. Light seems to be coming from behind the standing woman.
